roles.holdout: Hold out format layouts, endian combinations, nesting depths, and corruption operators with all mutated siblings grouped.
roles.artifact: Final environment handle resolves `DecoderCandidate` containing native artifact hash, field map, bounds contract, and executable witnesses.

donor_sources.observation: Extracts syntax structure from Python; native binary parsing is a proposed transfer.

roles.context: External OBSERVATION_STREAM and SEGMENT_STATE retain time order, covariates, missingness, policy revisions, and prior detections.
roles.program: Root programs sequential tests, recursively compares segment explanations, and buffers causal decisions using only observations available then.
roles.data: Training streams contain abrupt drift, gradual drift, recurring regimes, seasonal variation, isolated spikes, and workload shifts.
roles.oracle: Known simulated change schedules and independent predictive scoring validate controlled detection; real change attribution remains provisional.
roles.failure: One latency spike must not trigger permanent relearning, while persistent conditional degradation must not be averaged away.
roles.holdout: Hold out drift generators, time scales, and regime recurrence patterns.
roles.artifact: Return REGIME_SEGMENTS with detection times, evidence windows, uncertainty, and scoped adaptation recommendations.

donor_sources.observation: Strategy selection uses fixed confidence weights and coarse success-rate thresholds.

roles.name: Discriminating experiment designer
roles.brief: Train an experiment RLM to choose permitted probes that distinguish current hypotheses under realistic costs and controls.
roles.context: External HYPOTHESES, PROBE_MENU, and OBSERVATIONS preserve predicted outcomes, costs, confounders, constraints, and uncertainty.
roles.program: Root programs design comparisons, recursively inspects discriminants, and buffers preregistered predictions before any governed probe executes.
roles.data: Training uses causal simulators and owned diagnostic fixtures with irrelevant tests, expensive discriminants, and interacting mechanisms.
roles.oracle: Independent environment outcomes score final diagnosis and cost; generated prediction prose cannot serve as experimental truth.
roles.failure: A historically useful cheap test must be rejected when both current hypotheses predict the same result.
roles.holdout: Hold out fault mechanisms, probe names, and cost schedules.
roles.artifact: Return EXPERIMENT_DESIGN with controls, predicted branches, stopping rules, required permissions, and actual observation bindings.

donor_sources.observation: Causal relationships are requested as text; the scientific workflow leaves causal analysis unimplemented.

roles.name: Critical-path evidence analyst
roles.brief: Train a critical-path RLM to identify which dependency delays actually constrain end-to-end completion rather than summing durations.
roles.context: External EXECUTION_DAG and TIMING_INTERVALS retain dependency edges, overlap, queueing, clock domains, and missing spans.
roles.program: Root programs DAG timing calculations, recursively resolves uncertain edges, and buffers path alternatives with sensitivity to assumptions.
roles.data: Training uses generated schedules and owned concurrent fixtures with overlap, contention, delayed readiness, and incomplete instrumentation.
roles.oracle: An independent scheduler oracle checks controlled makespans and critical paths; uncertain clocks require interval bounds.
roles.failure: The longest individual task need not be critical when another dependency chain determines completion.
roles.holdout: Hold out DAG shapes, concurrency limits, and clock-error regimes.
roles.artifact: Return CRITICAL_PATH_REPORT with checked edges, delay attribution, uncertainty bounds, and measurable optimization opportunities.

donor_sources.observation: Dependencies order actions, but outputs are not passed as typed prerequisite values.

roles.name: Quantitative claim checker
roles.brief: Train a quantitative RLM to turn performance assertions into executable calculations with explicit populations and failure accounting.
roles.context: External CLAIMS and MEASUREMENTS preserve metric definitions, units, sample identities, denominators, censoring, and candidate revisions.
roles.program: Root programs checked estimators, recursively audits inclusion rules, and buffers reproducible calculations rather than generated numerical confidence.
roles.data: Training includes benchmark claims, altered denominators, misleading averages, mixed units, zero bases, and missing observations.
roles.oracle: Independent numerical implementations verify controlled results; statistical uncertainty remains separate from deterministic arithmetic correctness.
roles.failure: A candidate timing out on half its requests must not claim universal improvement from the faster completed half.
roles.holdout: Hold out metric compositions, workload distributions, and missing-data patterns.
roles.artifact: Return CHECKED_QUANTITATIVE_CLAIM with computation, included observations, exclusions, uncertainty, and support status.

donor_sources.observation: The workflow supplies a fixed neutral prior and placeholder likelihood rather than fitted evidence models.

roles.name: Complete long-output enumerator
roles.brief: Train an enumeration RLM to extract every qualifying item from large corpora without truncation, duplicates, or invented completeness.
roles.context: External CORPUS_PARTITIONS, MATCH_RULES, and OUTPUT_BUFFER preserve partition boundaries, item identities, progress receipts, and ambiguity.
roles.program: Root programs partitioned scans, recursively delegates bounded extraction, and buffers deduplicated results with coverage checks before finalization.
roles.data: Training uses generated inventories, long local symbol lists, scattered matches, repeated entries, negative cases, and interrupted scans.
roles.oracle: Exact controlled predicates provide reference sets; semantic inclusion tasks use independently labeled corpora and explicit unresolved items.
roles.failure: Retrieving several relevant examples must not become a claim that all matching functions were enumerated.
roles.holdout: Hold out corpus size regimes, partition layouts, and predicate combinations.
roles.artifact: Return COMPLETE_ENUMERATION with result handle, counts, partition coverage, duplicates resolved, and unresolved membership.

donor_sources.observation: Retrieval merges heterogeneous scores; extracted notes have no statement-level evidence references.

roles.name: Multimodal evidence aligner
roles.brief: Train an alignment RLM to connect textual claims with the correct visual regions and preserve cross-modal disagreements.
roles.context: External PAGE_IMAGES, TEXT_SPANS, and REGION_CANDIDATES retain page hashes, coordinates, labels, captions, and extraction variants.
roles.program: Root programs cross-reference alignment, recursively inspects disputed regions, and buffers verified links plus inconsistent readings.
roles.data: Training combines generated charts and diagrams with known layouts, annotated papers, displaced captions, rotations, and extraction errors.
roles.oracle: Renderer metadata establishes synthetic alignment; independent visual annotation judges natural examples without pretending exact semantic ground truth.
roles.failure: A nearby caption must not attach the claim to the wrong panel when panel labels contradict proximity.
roles.holdout: Hold out figure layouts, modality combinations, and visual degradation families.
roles.artifact: Return MULTIMODAL_ALIGNMENT with region handles, textual anchors, alternatives, disagreement records, and validation provenance.

donor_sources.observation: Vision produces page transcription text; there is no structured equation, table, or cross-modal verification.

roles.name: Missingness and coverage analyst

roles.holdout: Hold out omission mechanisms, document structures, and censoring regimes.
roles.artifact: Return MISSINGNESS_REPORT with coverage, plausible mechanisms, sensitivity bounds, and prohibited conclusions.

roles.name: Behavioral test selector

roles.name: Flaky test diagnostician

roles.holdout: Hold out scheduling patterns, infrastructure perturbations, and test frameworks from training.
roles.artifact: Produce a flakiness-diagnosis root adapter, cause ranking, reproducible witness, and justified repair or quarantine proposal.

roles.name: Evaluator calibration analyst
roles.brief: Measure whether a role evaluator's confidence and labels predict independently verified outcomes instead of reinforcing self-assessment.
roles.context: Expose predictions, rubric versions, adjudicated outcomes, abstentions, and failure dispositions as external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively stratify error patterns, compute calibration diagnostics, and propose thresholds using only designated fitting data.
roles.data: Train roots on confident mistakes, valid abstentions, unavailable verification, and independently scored evaluation episodes.
roles.oracle: A fixed executable scorer calculates proper scoring rules and held-out false-acceptance rates from resolved outcomes.
roles.failure: A verifier timeout must remain unknown and cannot improve accuracy by becoming zero remaining defects.
roles.holdout: Hold out task families, rubric shifts, and confidence-distribution changes.
roles.artifact: Produce an evaluator-calibration root adapter, calibrated decision thresholds, uncertainty report, and untouched-holdout scoring receipt.

donor_sources.observation: Computes heuristic coherence and can treat absent post-analysis as no newly detected biases.

roles.name: Multiagent handoff planner
roles.brief: Transfer unfinished role work with enough executable state for another agent to continue without repeating settled actions.
roles.context: Keep context handles, completed obligations, pending effects, candidate identities, and unresolved questions in external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively summarize branch state by dependency, preserve exact references, and construct a minimal resumable handoff contract.
roles.data: Train roots on interrupted collaborations, complete handoffs, missing state, and duplicated-action counterexamples.
roles.oracle: An independent continuation runner checks whether the receiver completes the original task with no lost obligations.
roles.failure: A fluent handoff omitting an uncertain remote mutation must fail if the receiver blindly repeats it.
roles.holdout: Hold out agent pairings, task-tree shapes, and interruption locations.
roles.artifact: Produce a handoff root adapter, receiver-ready state artifact, unresolved-action ledger, and successful independent continuation evidence.

donor_sources.observation: Defines structured child answers, evidence, uncertainties, and tool-call evidence.

roles.name: Shared contract negotiator
roles.brief: Resolve incompatible interface assumptions between role implementations before their independently correct components are integrated.
roles.context: Expose proposed schemas, callers, callee behaviors, invariants, and version constraints in external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively compare obligations, generate compatible alternatives, and derive executable counterexamples for unresolved contract disagreements.
roles.data: Train roots on interface negotiations, compatible refinements, conflicting ownership assumptions, and silently weakened invariants.
roles.oracle: Independent consumer/provider contract tests score compatibility while preserving each party's nonnegotiable requirements.
roles.failure: Resolving a conflict by dropping a required error case must fail even if both components compile.
roles.holdout: Hold out interface families, ownership models, and version-skew combinations.
roles.artifact: Produce a contract-negotiation root adapter, agreed schema proposal, remaining disagreements, and bidirectional compatibility test artifacts.

donor_sources.observation: Defines subtask identity, assigned tier, requested tools, and success criteria.

roles.name: Asynchronous result reconciler
roles.brief: Assemble asynchronous role outputs into a coherent decision without losing completed work or accepting stale results.
roles.context: Store future identities, candidate generations, result fragments, cancellations, and dependency requirements in external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively match results to requested obligations, deduplicate completions, and isolate missing or incompatible branches.
roles.data: Train roots on reordered replies, duplicate deliveries, partial successes, cancelled calls, and stale candidate evaluations.
roles.oracle: A deterministic event-replay oracle checks exact result ownership, completion status, and final aggregate correctness.
roles.failure: A late answer from an earlier candidate generation must not satisfy the current candidate's verification obligation.
roles.holdout: Hold out completion permutations, failure mixtures, and aggregation structures.
roles.artifact: Produce a result-reconciliation root adapter, coherent aggregate artifact, unresolved branch list, and replayable ownership proof.

donor_sources.observation: Returns completed child results and usage in a structured degraded response.

roles.name: User correction prioritizer
roles.brief: Convert user corrections into precise objective changes while retaining authorized work that the correction does not supersede.
roles.context: Keep task hierarchy, original requirements, chronological corrections, current outputs, and authority boundaries in external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively identify affected obligations, update priorities, and invalidate only decisions contradicted by the new instruction.
roles.data: Train roots on narrow clarifications, cancellations, incompatible objective changes, and messages containing mere status questions.
roles.oracle: An independently authored requirement-state oracle checks intended scope changes and preservation of unaffected commitments.
roles.failure: Asking for a progress update must not cancel ongoing work or authorize unrelated deployment.
roles.holdout: Hold out paraphrase families, correction orderings, and ambiguous references requiring abstention.
roles.artifact: Produce a correction-prioritization root adapter, revised obligation graph, preserved commitments, and an explicit scope-change explanation.

donor_sources.observation: Applies queued cancellation or reprioritization to eligible goals and records resulting state changes.

roles.name: Input latency investigator
roles.brief: Find why terminal input stalls during tool discovery, training, or recursive execution without confusing rendering delay with admission delay.
roles.context: Expose PTY timestamps, event-loop spans, lock waits, network stalls, and input-buffer states in external REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively isolate latency intervals, compare controlled interventions, and propose the smallest change removing the blocking dependency.
roles.data: Train roots on stalled catalogs, mutex contention, rendering bursts, background training, and healthy slow-output cases.
roles.oracle: An independent PTY harness measures keystroke admission, command response, and preservation of partially typed input.
roles.failure: A cosmetic spinner that appears responsive while input remains blocked must fail the actual latency check.
roles.holdout: Hold out stall durations, terminal sizes, and concurrent background-task combinations.
roles.artifact: Produce an input-latency root adapter, causal blocking diagnosis, focused patch candidate, and measured PTY regression evidence.

donor_sources.observation: Exposes asynchronous swarm status, token, and prediction events to callers.

roles.name: Release admission examiner
roles.brief: Decide whether a tested code/model pair satisfies release obligations without confusing recorded assertions with verified evidence.
roles.context: Keep candidate bytes, role adapter identity, compatibility results, acceptance contracts, and unresolved failures in REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively evaluate each obligation, challenge unsupported claims, and distinguish promotable, rejected, and incomplete candidate pairs.
roles.data: Train roots on valid releases, forged receipts, mismatched binaries, failed hidden tests, and unsupported activation claims.
roles.oracle: An independent release harness checks actual instruction changes, retained state, contract behavior, and serving identity.
roles.failure: A process retaining its PID after exec must not count as uninterrupted in-memory code replacement.
roles.holdout: Hold out native/model pairings, release failure combinations, and ABI transitions.
roles.artifact: Produce a release-admission root adapter, obligation verdict, rejected claims, and reproducible qualification or rollback instructions.

donor_sources.observation: Requires nonempty evidence strings for every declared acceptance criterion before completion.

roles.name: Resource forecast analyst
roles.brief: Forecast role training and recursive execution resources using measured cohorts, uncertainty, and correct dimensional relationships.
roles.context: Expose workload features, observed tokens, peak memory, device time, pricing units, and comparable episodes in REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively decompose demand, estimate intervals from eligible cohorts, and identify measurements dominating forecast uncertainty.
roles.data: Train roots on actual resource receipts, capacity failures, censored runs, and misleading average-only summaries.
roles.oracle: A held-out execution meter scores forecast error, interval coverage, and violations of declared hard limits.
roles.failure: Bytes per request multiplied by requests per second is bandwidth, not memory without a retention duration.
roles.holdout: Hold out device types, input-length regimes, and recursion-topology combinations.
roles.artifact: Produce a resource-forecast root adapter, units-checked bounds, cohort qualification report, and predicted-versus-observed resource receipt.

donor_sources.observation: Computes total usage including input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens.

roles.name: Synthetic fixture author
roles.brief: Generate adversarial executable fixtures with known answers that teach role procedures rather than memorized superficial cues.
roles.context: Keep task grammars, semantic rules, seeds, required edge cases, and independent reference implementations in REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively compose cases, derive answers through separate reference code, and reject fixtures whose labels depend on the candidate.
roles.data: Train roots on validated fixture generators, ambiguous cases, accidental answer leaks, and independently discovered missing boundaries.
roles.oracle: A second implementation verifies answer consistency, mutation sensitivity, determinism, and absence of hidden label channels.
roles.failure: A generated fixture placing its expected answer inside the visible filename must fail leakage validation.
roles.holdout: Hold out grammar productions, semantic combinations, and generator seed families.
roles.artifact: Produce a fixture-authoring root adapter, deterministic task generator, sealed oracle outputs, and independent generator-validation report.

donor_sources.observation: Computes exact normalized-label precision, recall, and F1 without generating independent task fixtures.

roles.name: Interoperability conformance examiner
roles.brief: Check that role runtimes honor negotiated protocol contracts across clients without mistaking permissive parsing for compatibility.
roles.context: Expose protocol versions, message traces, capability negotiations, transport framing, and expected state transitions in REPL variables.
roles.program: Recursively enumerate boundary cases, generate protocol probes, and compare actual behavior against explicit conformance rules.
roles.data: Train roots on valid exchanges, malformed envelopes, reordered notifications, cancellation races, and unsupported-version responses.
roles.oracle: An independent state-machine harness scores framing, identity, lifecycle, and effect semantics against controlled clients.
roles.failure: A successful initialization followed by tool calls using another session's identity must fail conformance.
roles.holdout: Hold out client implementations, transport fragmentation patterns, and version-transition combinations.
roles.artifact: Produce an interoperability root adapter, executable conformance suite, minimal failing traces, and supported-contract matrix.

donor_sources.observation: Normalizes tool lists from supported response-envelope shapes.

modes.name: Executable curriculum compiler
modes.mechanism: Compile a task grammar with explicit difficulty axes, valid transformations, and known failure labels. Generate positive and negative episodes, retaining their originating family identifiers. Train the role's root policy on a balanced development curriculum and expose a reproducible curriculum-build command.
modes.acceptance: Reject a generator that changes the answer without updating its reference or produces duplicate families under different seeds. Measure valid-case coverage and trained-root success separately.

modes.name: Teacher rejection distillation
modes.mechanism: Collect multiple executable teacher trajectories per development task. Replay their programs against the fixed oracle, reject incorrect or incomplete episodes, and deduplicate shared derivations before extracting root action targets. Distill accepted trajectories into the role policy with balanced family sampling.
modes.acceptance: A fluent teacher episode containing the expected answer but an incorrect executable result must be excluded. Compare the trained root against its initial checkpoint on untouched families.

modes.name: Faithful root-turn supervision
modes.mechanism: Export each root decision as its exact preceding visible history and that decision's generated code. Preserve environment object identities and recursive child receipts. Train only the current root target, masking earlier turns, child replies, and tool observations; verify masks after the actual renderer tokenizes each sample.
modes.acceptance: Reject a sample whose prefix contains a later observation. A deliberately relabeled child response must receive no root target loss, and the exported sequence must replay exactly.

modes.name: Learned execution-error recovery
modes.mechanism: Construct paired episodes containing a recoverable syntax, schema, or reference error and an independently verified repair. Train the root to inspect execution feedback, preserve completed work, and generate the smallest valid continuation. Keep original and corrected code plus the repair transformation.
modes.acceptance: Inject an undefined buffer and a completed effect before the failure. Recovery must resolve the buffer without repeating the effect; inventing a final answer cannot count as repair.

modes.name: Counterfactual branch preference training
modes.mechanism: Fork identical development states into isolated resettable environment snapshots or a fixed replay oracle with matched randomness. Reject comparisons when reset fidelity is uncertain. Execute alternative root programs under equal budgets, derive preferences from correctness then resource use, and train a declared preference objective on root continuations.
modes.acceptance: A shorter incorrect branch must lose to a longer correct branch. Swapping presentation order must preserve the preference, and branches with different starting states must be rejected as unmatched.

modes.name: Verifiable terminal-reward learning
modes.mechanism: Run bounded on-policy root rollouts with a fixed leaf policy and independently computed terminal task reward. Record policy versions and action ownership, reject overly stale trajectories, and train the root with an explicitly selected reinforcement-learning objective. Separate correctness constraints from efficiency rewards. Pin resolved reference labels before scoring; disputed or unavailable judgments remain unknown.
modes.acceptance: An empty action program, forged success flag, or omitted failing partition must never receive success reward. Confirm that a genuine verified completion produces the declared reward and a reloadable parameter update.

modes.name: Learned semantic batch control
modes.mechanism: Expose variable-size partitions and token estimates to the root. Train it to choose semantic batch boundaries, call children on those batches, and join outputs by stable item identity. Include interactions crossing naive byte boundaries and charge actual calls and processed tokens.
modes.acceptance: A boundary splitting a required dependency must trigger regrouping or explicit reconciliation. Compare fixed-size batching with learned batching under identical task and cost limits, retaining missing and duplicated items as failures.

modes.name: Adaptive recursion-depth policy
modes.mechanism: Create development instances whose useful decomposition ranges from direct environment computation to nested child RLMs. Train the root to decide between a leaf call and another recursive environment based on task structure and remaining budget. Record the actual tree rather than a declared depth.
modes.acceptance: A simple case must not gain reward from unnecessary recursion. A nested case must preserve dependent intermediate results, while attempts to exceed the host depth limit fail without changing that limit.

modes.name: Evidence-based stopping policy
modes.mechanism: Train a root decision among continue, return a verified environment result, and terminate unresolved. Development episodes include misleading high confidence, repetitive verification, and unresolved obligations. Optimize task completion with explicit observation requirements and costs, using oracle results rather than self-reported confidence.
modes.acceptance: Repeated identical child opinions cannot satisfy a missing obligation. A complete verified result should survive the stop decision unchanged; exhausted budgets must produce unresolved status instead of fabricated success.

modes.name: Learned context-access planning
modes.mechanism: Expose context-region descriptors and bounded reads while keeping the full input outside the root window. Train the root to generate access programs that retrieve discriminating regions and recursively examine relevant slices. Log coverage, read amplification, and every region supporting the final artifact.
modes.acceptance: Plant decisive information outside the usual prefix and supply a plausible distractor near the beginning. A policy that answers from previews alone must fail the oracle, and an unbounded full-context copy must be detected.

modes.name: Coverage-directed recursive traversal
modes.mechanism: Represent task partitions and their dependencies as an explicit coverage graph. Train the root to traverse unresolved frontiers, dispatch independent work, and mark a node complete only when its typed result satisfies the role contract. Preserve coverage certificates with the output object.
modes.acceptance: Drop one required region while returning a plausible aggregate. The completeness check must reject it; duplicate completion messages cannot compensate for a missing node or inflate coverage.

modes.name: Verified long-output assembly
modes.mechanism: Train the root to assemble semantically required role outputs exceeding one generation, using an expected coverage manifest and externally checked fragments. Return the typed result handle and digest with streaming backpressure. Padding cannot satisfy output length; validate the whole artifact against domain obligations after assembly.
modes.acceptance: A correct prefix followed by silent truncation must fail completeness. Reordering asynchronous fragments or repeating one fragment must be caught before final publication, without copying the whole output into the root prompt.

modes.name: Learned persistent-buffer reuse
modes.mechanism: Train the root to recognize reusable intermediate results by their context, procedure, and dependency identities. Maintain external result buffers with explicit invalidation conditions; recursive children receive scoped references. Measure saved work alongside semantic correctness, including reuse across resumed episodes.
modes.acceptance: Change one dependency while leaving the buffer's human-readable label unchanged. The policy must recompute affected results and retain unaffected ones; stale reuse or unnecessary replay of completed effects fails.

modes.name: Contradiction-guided program revision
modes.mechanism: Generate episodes where two independently sourced intermediate results conflict. Train the root to localize the conflicting assumptions, recursively investigate discriminating evidence, and revise dependent program steps. Retain both original claims and the evidence that resolved or preserved the disagreement.
modes.acceptance: Several copied supporting reports must not overwhelm one valid counterexample. If the conflict remains unresolved, the output must preserve that state rather than select whichever child answered last.

modes.name: Cost-aware child-policy selection
modes.mechanism: Offer a pinned pool of child policies with measured capabilities and costs. Train the root to choose a child and context slice for each subproblem while recording actual serving identities. Optimize verified role outcomes under a shared budget, preserving conditional performance data.
modes.acceptance: A cheap child that fails a rare required case must not be selected solely from its average score. Swap an endpoint's model revision and require identity failure rather than silently crediting the trained root.

modes.name: Learned asynchronous recursion
modes.mechanism: Expose bounded futures for recursive calls and train submit, await, batch, and cancel decisions on controlled completion distributions. Reservations span all descendants. Keep completed result identities stable and ensure training and inference scheduling never block the terminal input handler.
modes.acceptance: Delay a required child indefinitely while delivering other results out of order. The system must remain responsive, preserve partial work, and report unresolved completeness; dropping the slow child cannot manufacture a successful fast result.

modes.name: Learned typed role handoffs
modes.mechanism: Train the root to delegate through explicit input, output, evidence, and uncertainty schemas while its partner policies stay frozen. Child prompts contain sufficient scoped context and exact verified dependency values. Failed or incompatible handoffs return typed diagnostics that the root can repair.
modes.acceptance: A partner omitting required evidence or returning a result from another task must be rejected. Matching prose labels cannot replace schema and identity checks, and a repaired handoff must preserve its original authority.

modes.name: Active example acquisition
modes.mechanism: Train the root to select the next development example or oracle query using uncertainty, task importance, and expected decision benefit. Record selection probabilities and the population from which examples were chosen. Keep a fixed independent evaluation distribution for measuring actual improvement.
modes.acceptance: A policy that repeatedly samples easy successes must lose coverage credit. A highly uncertain but irrelevant example must not outrank a decisive missing case merely because it produces a larger confidence change.

modes.name: Role-specific counterexample adversary
modes.mechanism: Train an auxiliary root policy to generate valid challenging inputs for the role's current candidate behavior. A fixed independent referee checks input validity and confirms violations. Retain diverse minimized witnesses, and evaluate the main role against non-adaptive sealed cases as well.
modes.acceptance: A malformed input, altered reference, or induced harness failure cannot earn adversarial success. A genuine in-contract error must produce a reproducible witness tied to the exact candidate and environment revisions.

modes.name: Invariant-conditioned program generation
modes.mechanism: Attach explicit executable invariants to development tasks and train the root to carry them through decomposition, child-result consumption, and final assembly. Check invariants outside the policy, distinguishing proven bounded conditions from sampled checks and unresolved assumptions.
modes.acceptance: A candidate that satisfies visible examples while violating a required invariant on a boundary case must fail. Removing the check or replacing it with the root's assurance must not change the verdict.

modes.name: Learned minimal-witness extraction
modes.mechanism: Train the root to shrink a failure of this role's program, preserving its original domain obligations and fixed failure identity. It removes candidate context or program regions, recursively checks reductions, and stores a verified failure witness separately from the normal role result. Measure size and replay reliability separately.
modes.acceptance: Deleting the evidence until a different error appears must be rejected as failure drift. The final witness must reproduce the original oracle mismatch, and timeout cannot establish that a removed region was unnecessary.

modes.name: Calibrated role abstention
modes.mechanism: Train an explicit abstention decision using development outcomes and calibrate its thresholds on a separate calibration split. Preserve task difficulty, evidence availability, and error categories. Evaluate selective accuracy together with retained coverage so refusing every task cannot appear useful.
modes.acceptance: A timeout or unavailable oracle must remain unknown. Report the retained-task denominator and coverage; a high-confidence wrong answer and an always-abstain policy must both fail their predeclared acceptance conditions.

modes.name: Drift-adaptive role policy
modes.mechanism: Train the root to distinguish transient anomalies, changed input distributions, and changed task semantics from chronological observations. It selects bounded diagnostic probes and proposes scoped relearning. Keep an immutable pre-change checkpoint and evaluate detection delay, false alarms, and post-change correctness.
modes.acceptance: One extreme outlier must not trigger wholesale relearning. A sustained change affecting the role's contract must be detected without access to future observations, and unaffected task families must retain their prior behavior.

modes.name: Dependency-scoped retraining
modes.mechanism: Bind training episodes and learned procedures to content and environment dependencies. When one dependency changes, select the affected development slices and train a bounded role update with replay from unaffected families. Version the dependency graph and resulting checkpoint separately.
modes.acceptance: Editing content at the same path must reopen dependent learning claims. Retraining only on the changed slice must not hide regressions elsewhere, and unrelated episodes must not be relabeled stale merely to improve reported coverage.

modes.name: Checkpoint recovery policy training
modes.mechanism: Create interrupted role episodes with committed buffers, pending child calls, and explicit effect receipts. Train the root to reconstruct logical state, reconcile pending work, and continue from a compatible model/environment tuple. Treat unavailable state as a recoverable diagnostic rather than invented memory.
modes.acceptance: Resume after an effect completed but before its acknowledgement was recorded. Reconcile the receipt instead of repeating the effect; incompatible state schemas or changed model identities must prevent a misleading continuation claim.

modes.name: Hierarchical context navigation
modes.mechanism: Build lossless external indexes over task contexts and train the root to navigate coarse descriptors into exact evidence regions. Child RLMs inspect selected subtrees; summaries guide navigation but never replace authoritative content. Record access paths and evidence references for the final artifact.
modes.acceptance: A summary that omits a decisive exception must not erase the exception from the answer. Force a query requiring descent into a rarely accessed subtree and verify the exact underlying evidence is consumed.

modes.name: Constrained Pareto policy distillation
modes.mechanism: Collect independently verified root trajectories with quality, latency, memory, and cost measurements. Construct a constrained frontier and distill policies conditioned on declared operating budgets. Keep correctness and capability rules as hard requirements rather than exchangeable score terms.
modes.acceptance: A fast invalid trajectory must never enter the feasible frontier. Tightening a resource budget should produce a valid lower-cost policy or explicit infeasibility, not an unreported reduction in required task coverage.

modes.name: Measured cross-family transfer
modes.mechanism: Train the role on selected development families, then compare adapted and unadapted roots on disjoint family structures with fixed leaves. Include component ablations and a negative-transfer condition. Retain task ancestry so apparent transfer cannot come from shared templates or answer leakage.
modes.acceptance: A learned shortcut that works only for one identifier or ordering must fail on renamed and structurally changed cases. Attribute any gain to the trained root and report families harmed by the update.

modes.name: Capability-constrained program learning
modes.mechanism: Train the root to generate useful programs within a declared host-service contract, using structured action schemas and explicit capability denials as observations. Constraints shape valid proposals, but the host still authorizes every effect independently. Evaluate task completion under different legitimate grant sets.
modes.acceptance: A recursive child requesting broader authority cannot obtain it from generated code or a rewritten schema. The root must select an allowed alternative or report inability, and a denied action cannot be recorded as completed.

modes.name: Joint model and runtime admission
modes.mechanism: Train the role to identify incompatible model, adapter, child-policy, environment, and native-procedure versions. Store a typed admission plan, pinned tuple, receipts, and decision in feature_artifact; role_result retains the domain artifact. A separate authority validates compatibility and serializes admission against revocation.
modes.acceptance: An unchanged parent generation with a revoked receipt must still fail admission. Native-improvement claims require changed instruction bytes, retained heap/session state, and no exec; a trained model's confidence alone cannot authorize activation.

prompts.oracle: An independent state-machine harness scores framing, identity, lifecycle, and effect semantics against controlled clients.
prompts.domain_challenge: A successful initialization followed by tool calls using another session's identity must fail conformance.
